info.name: NextDesk
info.summary: Device sign-in and policy for NextDesk OS
info.description:
Server side of [NextDesk OS](https://github.com/nexed-tech/nextdesk), a ChromeOS-style desktop for Nextcloud. Without NextDesk OS computers this app has nothing to manage.
What it provides:
- Devices sign in with a Nextcloud app password (Login Flow v2) and log their browser in with a one-time token, so users sign in once. - NextDesk policy (e.g. how long a device may be used offline) with a global value, group overrides (strictest group wins) and user overrides. Managed under Administration settings → Security, with `occ nextdesk:policy` or the OCS API. - The device policy URL for this server's NextDesk machines (one signed policy for all of them), set on the admin page. - NextDesk computers (Administration settings → NextDesk computers): the computers that reported in, their last contact, last user, device policy in force, version and install date, and their disk recovery keys (escrow: stored encrypted, every read logged). Can be delegated to a group, such as a helpdesk.
